name: Judd's Hill Wine Sales Evaluation Rubric
description: Specialized rubric for evaluating wine tasting room sales interactions with experienced enthusiasts at Judd's Hill.

criteria.name: Sophisticated Greeting and Welcome
criteria.description: How effectively does the staff member welcome experienced guests and establish a premium experience?

scoringLevels.description: Generic greeting that fails to acknowledge guest experience level
Basic greeting with minimal attempt to gauge wine knowledge
Appropriate greeting that acknowledges guest experience without personalization
Warm, sophisticated greeting that shows awareness of guest wine background
Exceptional welcome that makes experienced guests feel valued and recognized for their wine knowledge

criteria.name: Advanced Rapport Building
criteria.description: How well does the staff member connect with experienced wine enthusiasts and their preferences?

scoringLevels.description: No attempt to connect with guests' specific wine background or interests
Basic questions about wine preferences without meaningful follow-up
Some rapport-building about wine preferences and lifestyle with adequate follow-up
Strong connection through sophisticated wine conversations and personal details (new home, other club memberships)
Exceptional rapport building that uncovers specific wine values, preferences for European styles, and seamlessly connects to Judd's Hill offerings

criteria.name: Judd's Hill Unique Story
criteria.description: How effectively does the staff member communicate Judd's Hill's unique artistic roots and handcrafted approach?

scoringLevels.description: No mention of Judd's Hill's unique history or artisan approach
Brief, generic mention of winery background without emphasizing unique aspects
Adequate explanation of Judd's Hill's artistic roots and small-lot production
Compelling storytelling about Judd's Hill's unique character with connections to guests' wine values
Passionate, sophisticated narrative that positions Judd's Hill's artistic heritage and craftsmanship as distinct from Silver Oak

criteria.name: Sophisticated Wine Storytelling
criteria.description: How well does the staff member use sophisticated storytelling and analogies for experienced wine enthusiasts?

scoringLevels.description: Basic technical descriptions without sophisticated analogies
Generic wine descriptions that don't address preferences for European styles
Appropriate stories and analogies connecting to lower alcohol preferences
Advanced storytelling that compares Judd's Hill to European styles and highlights terroir elements
Exceptional, sophisticated analogies that perfectly illustrate Judd's Hill's unique characteristics for discerning palates

criteria.name: Recognition of Subtle Buying Signals
criteria.description: How well does the staff member notice and respond to subtle buying signals from experienced guests?

scoringLevels.description: Misses subtle buying signals completely
Notices obvious signals but misses more subtle indicators of interest
Recognizes main buying signals with appropriate follow-up
Skillfully identifies nuanced interest cues and responds with sophisticated approaches
Expertly recognizes and acts on the most subtle buying signals without appearing pushy

criteria.name: Non-Intrusive Data Capture
criteria.description: How effectively does the staff member collect information from wine-savvy guests?

scoringLevels.description: No attempt to capture guest data or preferences
Awkward or overly direct attempts at data collection
Acceptable data capture but without clear value proposition for experienced guests
Smooth, sophisticated data collection that feels beneficial and exclusive
Masterful, completely natural data capture that makes guests eager to share contact information

criteria.name: Sophisticated Ask for the Sale
criteria.description: How effectively does the staff member ask for wine purchases from experienced collectors?

scoringLevels.description: No ask or inappropriate selling approach for sophisticated guests
Generic sales pitch not tailored to experienced enthusiasts
Reasonable sales approach that acknowledges guest sophistication
Confident, tailored ask for purchase at appropriate time with compelling rationale
Exceptional, sophisticated sales approach that makes purchasing feel like a natural extension of the experience

criteria.name: Comparative Wine Recommendations
criteria.description: How well does the staff member recommend wines in contrast to Silver Oak membership experience?

scoringLevels.description: Generic recommendations that ignore Silver Oak experience or European preferences
Basic recommendations with minimal consideration of sophisticated palate
Appropriate recommendations highlighting lower alcohol options
Well-tailored recommendations that respectfully differentiate from Silver Oak
Masterful recommendations that perfectly complement Silver Oak membership while showcasing Judd's Hill's unique qualities

criteria.name: Premium Wine Club Presentation
criteria.description: How effectively does the staff member present the wine club as complementary to Silver Oak membership?

scoringLevels.description: No mention of wine club or inappropriate positioning against Silver Oak
Basic wine club information without addressing existing club memberships
Adequate explanation of benefits with some customization for experienced members
Sophisticated presentation positioning the club as complementary to Silver Oak
Exceptional, non-pushy wine club presentation that makes membership feel essential for their new Yountville home

criteria.name: Local Expertise and Recommendations
criteria.description: How well does the staff member provide restaurant recommendations and showcase local knowledge?

scoringLevels.description: No local recommendations even when opportunity arises
Generic recommendations without consideration for new homeowners
Adequate restaurant suggestions when directly asked
Proactive, well-curated recommendations that anticipate needs as new homeowners
Exceptional insider knowledge that positions staff member as an invaluable resource for their new Yountville lifestyle

performanceLevels.name: Needs Improvement
performanceLevels.description: Insufficient approach to sophisticated guests requiring extensive training

performanceLevels.name: Developing
performanceLevels.description: Basic skills present but lacking sophistication needed for experienced enthusiasts

performanceLevels.name: Proficient
performanceLevels.description: Competent interaction with good understanding of experienced guest needs

performanceLevels.name: Excellent
performanceLevels.description: Very effective approach with strong connections to sophisticated guests

performanceLevels.name: Outstanding
performanceLevels.description: Exceptional sales interaction perfectly tailored to experienced wine enthusiasts
